h1: Dinso Resort & Villas Ko Chang — an IHG luxury resort reborn from The Emerald Cove
intro: Anyone who visited Koh Chang years ago may remember The Emerald Cove — a large resort on Klong Prao Beach · It closed for a major renovation in 2023 and reopened in 2024 as Dinso Resort & Villas Ko Chang under Vignette Collection by IHG, IHG's first collection brand bringing one-of-a-kind properties together · 166 rooms and villas, a large pool, a spa and as many as 5 dining venues · from approx. ฿4,500/night
galleryAlts: The large swimming pool at Dinso Resort & Villas Ko Chang with sun loungers and cabanas
A modern, warmly lit guest room at Dinso Resort Koh Chang with a soft bed
The resort set among green gardens on a quiet cove south of Klong Prao Beach

body.html: Dinso sits on a small cove at the southern tip of Klong Prao Beach, Koh Chang — not right on the sand like some resorts, but a few minutes' walk reaches a long white-sand beach · The upside of this setting is that it is very quiet and private, wrapped in green gardens and low hills · If you want a calm resort for genuine relaxation rather than beachfront partying, this fits well.

After the major renovation, all 166 rooms and villas were redesigned · They range from Deluxe and Premium Rooms up to Sea View Suites, Pool Access villas and Private Pool Villas · Real guest reviews repeatedly mention spacious rooms, modern design, comfortable beds and a strong sense of privacy · Some Sea View Suites stretch to 107 sqm — larger than equivalent rooms at many resorts on the island.
"The room was huge, beautifully designed, and the bed was incredibly comfortable · You can walk straight from the pool to the beach, and it's quiet enough to feel like a private resort."

The heart of Dinso is a large swimming pool with cabanas and sun loungers · Many rooms are Pool Access, so you can step into the water straight from your terrace · There is also a full-service spa, a gym, and lounge/co-working spaces with Wi-Fi · On the dining side there are as many as 5 restaurants and bars serving Thai and international cuisine · Breakfast comes up often in a good light — a varied buffet with an egg station, fresh juices and Asian options.

Real guest reviews praise the friendly, attentive staff · The atmosphere is romantic and calm, well suited to couples and honeymooners · The sunset views from the resort side are lovely too · An overall 9.4 from 236 Trip.com reviews and 4.7 of 5 on TripAdvisor — numbers that show the resort has done its homework since reopening.

There are some honest caveats · Because the resort sits on a slope above the cove, reaching the beach means walking down steps, and at high tide the front beach gets narrow · A few reviews mention a damp, musty smell in some ground-floor rooms (a common issue in the island's humid climate) · And being newly reopened, service isn't always seamless — for example, long queues at breakfast stations during busy hours · Food and spa prices on site also run higher than outside options.

The bottom line for anyone on the fence: if you want a 5-star international-brand resort on Koh Chang with stylish modern rooms, a big pool and high privacy, and you don't mind not stepping straight onto sand from your door — Dinso is a well-rounded choice · But if the heart of your trip is lounging on the beach in front of your room all day, weigh the cove-on-a-slope location here first.

honestSummary: Dinso is one of the best international-brand 5-star resorts on Koh Chang right now — fresh, stylish rooms, a big pool and high privacy · but you should accept that the cove-on-a-slope setting isn't right on the sand, and a few service details still need ironing out since it only reopened recently.
honestChecks: If the heart of your trip is lounging on the beach in front of your room all day — this resort sits on a slope above the cove and the beach is reached via steps → consider a resort right on the sand on Klong Prao or Kai Bae beach
If you're sensitive to musty smells — some ground-floor rooms have reviews mentioning odour → ask for an upper-floor or freshly cleaned, well-ventilated room at check-in

If you expect flawless, seamless service like a long-established resort — Dinso only reopened in 2024 and some moments still need polish → allow for breakfast queues at peak times and flag any requests in advance

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Dinso Resort & Villas Ko Chang

faq.q: What was Dinso Resort Ko Chang called before?
faq.a: It was reimagined from The Emerald Cove Koh Chang · It closed for a major renovation in 2023 and reopened in 2024 as Dinso Resort & Villas Ko Chang under Vignette Collection by IHG · all rooms and facilities were redesigned.

faq.q: Where on Koh Chang is Dinso Resort, and is it beachfront?
faq.a: It sits on a small cove at the southern tip of Klong Prao Beach · It's not directly on the sand, but a few minutes' walk reaches a long white-sand beach · The setting is quiet and private among green gardens · At high tide the front beach narrows and you reach it via steps.

faq.q: How much does Dinso Resort cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿4,500/night for a Deluxe Premium · They rise through Premium Rooms, Sea View Pool Access rooms and a 107 sqm Sea View Suite · Prices vary by season and package, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Dinso Resort best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for couples, honeymooners and anyone wanting a quiet, private 5-star resort · stylish modern rooms, a big pool and a romantic mood · It's less suited to beachfront partygoers or those who want to step straight onto sand from their door.

faq.q: What is breakfast like at Dinso, and is it included?
faq.a: Breakfast is a varied buffet with an egg station, fresh juices and Asian options, and it's frequently praised in reviews · During busy hours the live-cooking stations can get queues, so go a little earlier · Some packages include breakfast — always check when booking.
